title: state/last.json
description: Spec 1 §5 and Spec 9 §4 — ShowState for restore-last-state, with how the run that wrote it ended: the ShowState of Spec 3 §2, as the projection writes it, under state, and the facts of the run beside it. The facts are optional, so a file from before Spec 9 still reads.

writtenAt.description: When the file was written, ISO 8601 in the machine's time zone.

run.description: The uuid of the run that wrote it.

clean.description: True only when the engine stopped on request, after the shutdown macro.

restored.description: True for the first minute after the engine put a last state back.

pendingClears.description: The popup slots with a clear-after still counting (Spec 6 §7).
